description: Hochwasser_WFS - Wassertiefe_HQ_Extrem - OGC API Features is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The map service (WFS group) presents selected geodata from the field of floods.:The flood hazard map HQ Extreme shows the extent of floods (floodplains and water depth) in events that can occur on a statistical average much less frequently than every 100 years, i.e. a low probability flood scenario. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "_WFS - Water depth _HQ _Extrem - OGC API Features" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Überschwemmung, Hochwasserabfluß, Hochwasser, Hochwasserschutz, Hochwasserprognose, infoFeatureAccessService. The listing shows 2025-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
